caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary XML/PDF prints the IC50 unit as uM/mL; DBAASP linked rows store the same numeric values with ug/ml. No conversion is performed.
DRAMP lists broad antimicrobial/anticancer activity and linear/free-termini metadata, while the primary paper supports cytotoxicity and a cyclic hexapeptide structure.
The paper reports compounds 2-4 lack considerable cell death properties, but local material does not provide exact row-level values.
The local material supports cytotoxic phenotype, not a direct molecular mechanism.

summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair recovered three primary IC50 rows, reconciled linked DBAASP/DRAMP records with explicit unit and structure cautions, replaced the framework-test mechanism note with bounded phenotypic/structure evidence, and separated material, validator, semantic, and publication-grade layers.
